blocked_by.why: R6 supplies the unbounded closure, but the ANSWER is the minimum hop count. §2.3 restriction 2 makes unbounded Expand structural closure only, and `<into>.depth` on an `unbounded(a)` from one anchor is the min depth to each node — but the template needs the distance to a second BOUND node as the returned scalar, which is `path-shortest-length`, a §1.4 non-goal. B1 App-A upholds that SP alone is the blocker.
